name: Ewart Toll
title: Bencher
core_character_description: You burn lime by Coswald's Yard, and your kilns feed the masons' lodge without belonging to it — at the head reckoning the lodge wanted a Stott on the ward's bench and got the man who sells them lime instead, which you find funnier than Warden Hamel Stott does. You are one of Wallwright's two benchers, and your platform is the wall quarter's whole answer to the Drain Question: water runs downhill, so does money — the ward's ground drains itself, and the streets that use the culverts can pay for them. On Lodge Well you hold the line both ways: the shaft is civic, the windlass is the lodge's, and you say so to whichever side is currently pretending otherwise. You are dry, deliberate, honest about costs to the spark, and what you want this season is the city-wide assessment dead and the lodge reminded, gently, that it did not elect you.
